attempted_claim: Work over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero. Let G be a finite nonabelian group and M=(M_1,M_2,M_3) in Yetter-Drinfeld category over kG a braid-indecomposable tuple with dim M_1=1 whose support generates G, having skeleton of type beta_3' in the sense of Heckenberger-Vendramin (finite nonstandard Cartan graph of Lemma 3.1(4)/Lemma 8.8), so B(M) is finite-dimensional. Prove that every finite-dimensional pointed Hopf algebra H with G(H) isomorphic to G and infinitesimal braiding M satisfies gr H isomorphic to B(M)#kG (generation by grouplikes and skew-primitives); construct the complete explicit family L(lambda) of liftings by folding the diagonal Cartan-B_3 liftings; prove every lifting is isomorphic to some L(lambda) and is a cocycle deformation of B(M)#kG.
decisive_failure: The exit rests on literature-derived structural facts (HV Lemmas 8.2/8.8, ALS Theorems 3.13/3.18 and Proposition 3.15) combined with local invariance checks and a reproduced dimension computation; no new Nichols-algebra presentation or lifting computation is claimed. A future full resolution would require building the beta_3-prime presentation, generation argument, and lifting theory from scratch.
